valor: Four-year-old Pedro lives in the heart of São Paulo, in a neighborhood that is about to be demolished. Through his eyes, we witness a harsh adult world dominated by real estate speculation. Blurring the boundaries between documentary and childhood imagination, the film celebrates childhood, memory and the small but meaningful details of life, in contrast with an urban system driven by profit and neglect.
motivo: se quita lo que no es sinopsis; nada se escribe
